profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Target
profile.summary: Software Engineer with full stack experience using Java, Kotlin, IntelliJ, Spring Boot, React.Js, Node.js, Kafka, and NoSQL alongside an independent study of the Android space

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Doppler Platform (Global Logistics and Supply Chain)
•	System Ownership: Architected, deployed, and maintained 19 microservices and 3 micro-frontends, owning service boundaries and data contracts across a distributed ecosystem.
•	BFF & Data Integration: Led integration of 10+ upstream source systems; designed and managed backend-for-frontend (BFF) layers to aggregate and transform real-time data for downstream analytics.
•	Strategic Delivery: Owned the technical roadmap, design, and end-to-end development of a high-impact Multi-Year Strategic Planning tool, delivering data models reviewed at the C-suite level.
•	Partner Onboarding: Managed technical onboarding and system integration for 100+ global business partners, ensuring API reliability and operational continuity.
•	Engineering Quality & Platform Tooling
•	Developer Infrastructure: Independently built and open-sourced an internal Developer Dashboard utilized org-wide, unifying GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and CI/CD metrics into one visualization.
•	AI & Automation: Spearheaded team AI initiatives, establishing repositories for agentic workflows and standardizing an automated orchestration process for handling support tickets.
•	Cross-Team Reliability: Diagnosed systemic bugs within neighboring Data Transfer systems, providing engineering peers with reproduction steps, telemetry data, and architectural resolutions.
•	Team Leadership & Operational Excellence
•	Team Scaling & Mentorship: Scaled the engineering team from 2 to 9 software engineers; managed technical hiring, conducted interviews, and established the team onboarding framework.
•	Agile & Lifecycle Management: Directed quarterly sprint planning and milestone mapping for large-scale epics, refined Scrum processes to improve delivery predictability, and presented technical demonstrations to leadership.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Legacy Modernization: Maintained a legacy codebase while systematically migrating monolithic services to a distributed architecture using Java Spring Boot (backend) and React, Node.js, and Redux (frontend).
•	Infrastructure & Security: Managed server provisioning, network routing, and firewall configurations; configured secure application integration with central authentication servers.
•	CI/CD Pipeline Optimization: Led the upgrade of continuous integration and deployment pipelines to improve build performance, orchestrating implementation efforts across multiple engineering teams.
•	Cross-Functional Alignment: Acted as the technical liaison between server infrastructure, QA, and production teams to streamline release cycles and maintain operational maturity.

positions.title: Technology Associate
positions.description:
- Underwent training detailing top of the line technology in order to provide the most up to date solutions (ie. Networking – PoE networking switches, VLAN, DD-WRT, Access Point integration)
- Leveraged knowledge of leading tech to communicate and provide solutions regarding problems provided by customers

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked extensively with Thomson Reuters Inc, a large, multinational media and information firm, to support development of a commercial software application. 
- Developed and repaired utilities in the UI and CDO interfaces, built on a Java and XML backbone, to provide a better experience for the user using Eclipse and Microsoft’s Team Foundation Server.

projects.title: Stock Market Android App
projects.description: Design stages – pending on backend structure for the application, weighing benefits of Firebase, SQLite, and MYSQL, with a slant towards Firebase as scalability is likely not an issue. The application will present live stock market figures alongside market data using the IEX stock API, breaking news stories pulling from Google News API, scrape content from Reddit/Blog posts, etc. the app will house this data in order to provide a location for discussion of stock market trends.

projects.title: WUD Films Android App
projects.description: Designed and implemented the main algorithm behind the application. The application pulled information from the University webpage and displayed the dates and times of all films that were shown at the Wisconsin Union (South). This project utilized the Google Sheets API to pull information from Google spreadsheets and parsed relevant data to build JSoup queries which then crawled and pulled information directly from a web page, updating the application's information upon opening. This was an in-depth workaround due to the inexistence of a uniform backend (no DB).
